**BLUF:** Ukrainian long-range strikes have damaged the Kerch Bridge and hit Russian logistics vessels in the Gulf of Finland and off Libya, tightening pressure on Russian supply lines to Crimea and Africa Corps. Iran conducted missile/drone strikes on Bahrain targeting US-linked sites, prompting regional condemnations, while multiple tanker incidents in the Strait of Hormuz escalated maritime risk. Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure caused outages and civilian casualties in Dnipropetrovsk and Kyiv oblasts. China continues routine military exercises and live-fire drills in the East China Sea and Yellow Sea per official NAVWARNS. No major movement detected in Indo-Pacific or other quiet theatres beyond established patterns.

## 1. CHATTER AND THE INFORMATION ENVIRONMENT

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Pro-Ukrainian and monitoring accounts circulated updated OpenStreetMap imagery and analysis showing visible damage to the Kerch Bridge rail and road spans, with claims of Ukrainian Neptune and drone strikes isolating Russian forces in Crimea; posts by @SanderRegter and @OlenaRohoza reached hundreds of views, geolocating impacts but lacking independent confirmation beyond Ukrainian sources.[[1]](https://x.com/SanderRegter/status/2124566590956142672)[[2]](https://x.com/OlenaRohoza/status/2124566295945294278)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Accounts including @HedgehogGeopol and @FelastoryMedia reported Iranian IRGC Navy claims of two supertankers striking mines north and east of the Strait of Hormuz on 22 Nov, with unverified video of a tanker on fire near Fujairah; UKMTO noted a separate tanker incident in the Gulf of Oman, with Iranian claims widely amplified but unconfirmed by independent monitors.[[3]](https://x.com/HedgehogGeopol/status/2124568549117022364)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Multiple accounts discussed Iranian missile/drone strikes on Bahrain's Sitra industrial area and claimed hits on US Patriot radars at Al-Riffa/Awali bases, with videos of fires and air alerts circulating; @Osint_Ghost and @matishoshani posted summaries reaching moderate reach, citing IRGC statements and Bahraini intercepts.[[4]](https://x.com/Osint_Ghost/status/2124570343583228314)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Pro-Russian and OSINT accounts reported suspected Ukrainian sea-drone strikes on Russian vessels in Benghazi port (corvette Merkury/Mercury and cargo ship ASCALON) and the Gulf of Finland (Sparta II), with footage of impacts and Finnish towing operations; posts by @AnatoliUkraine, @ChallengerInUA and @sentdefender noted Kaliningrad loading links and Africa Corps supply disruption.[[5]](https://x.com/22NN_A/status/2124570514832474334)[[6]](https://x.com/ChallengerInUA/status/2124570195284852750)[[7]](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2124570511342555231)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Accounts highlighted Russian strikes on Dnipropetrovsk energy infrastructure and a Kyiv Oblast apartment building, with reports of casualties and outages; local and Ukrainian sources described double-tap tactics, while Russian MoD claims focused on military-industrial targets.[[8]](https://x.com/GrumpyNews_/status/2124550592605650971)

searched: Kerch Bridge; Hormuz tanker; Bahrain Iran missile; Benghazi Russian ship; Kaliningrad drone; Sparta II Finland; Dnipropetrovsk strike

## 2. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE
[OSINT - WEB] Ukrainska Pravda and Kyiv Independent (22 Nov) reported Russian missile/drone attacks on energy infrastructure in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast and a residential building in Dymer (Kyiv Oblast), causing outages, multiple casualties including children, and ongoing rescue operations.[[9]](https://x.com/begoniatulip/status/2124568465444884967)

[OSINT - WEB] Multiple outlets including BBC and gCaptain (22 Nov) confirmed suspected Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian vessels in the Gulf of Finland (Sparta II, towed by Finland) and Benghazi, Libya (cargo ship ASCALON and corvette Merkury), with Finnish authorities attributing the former to Ukraine.[[7]](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2124570511342555231)

[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent (22 Nov) noted Zelenskyy comments on Russian weekly missile totals (165) and US Patriot delays amid sustained Ukrainian deep strikes on Kerch Bridge logistics.[[9]](https://x.com/begoniatulip/status/2124568465444884967)

**Assessment:** Ukrainian deep-strike campaign is degrading Russian logistics to Crimea and overseas forces at moderate cost in Russian retaliation on Ukrainian rear areas; this improves Ukraine's position in attrition but risks escalation if Russian responses expand. Moderate confidence from consistent multi-source reporting on strikes and damage.

### MIDDLE EAST
[OSINT - WEB] Middle East Eye, Al Jazeera and others (22 Nov) reported Iranian IRGC missile/drone strikes on Bahrain industrial sites, with Bahraini intercepts, civilian alerts, and condemnations from Saudi Arabia and Qatar.[[9]](https://x.com/begoniatulip/status/2124568465444884967)

[OSINT - WEB] gCaptain, Reuters-linked reports and Middle East Eye (22 Nov) detailed multiple tanker incidents in/near the Strait of Hormuz, including Iranian claims of mine strikes on supertankers and UKMTO advisories.[[3]](https://x.com/HedgehogGeopol/status/2124568549117022364)

[OSINT - WEB] Jerusalem Post and others (22 Nov) covered Houthi claims of attacks on Saudi Rabigh refinery amid ongoing Red Sea tensions.[[9]](https://x.com/begoniatulip/status/2124568465444884967)

**Assessment:** Iranian actions in Bahrain and Hormuz raise the risk of broader Gulf escalation and shipping disruption; this weakens de-escalation prospects and pressures US/coalition responses. Moderate confidence from official statements and maritime advisories.

### INDO-PACIFIC
[SIGINT - VERIFIED] China MSA Zhejiang 浙航警1066/26 (issued ~2d ago) and related NAVWARNS detail live-fire and military exercises in the East China Sea and Yellow Sea/Bohai through 25 Nov, with specific coordinates and timings.[[9]](https://x.com/begoniatulip/status/2124568465444884967)

**Assessment:** Routine PLA activity continues without deviation from pattern; no indication of heightened Taiwan-related tension in window. High confidence from official navigational warnings.

### SOUTH AND CENTRAL ASIA
Quiet in window. No new headlines or verifiable chatter indicating movement.

### AFRICA
[OSINT - WEB] BBC, Guardian and Al Jazeera (22 Nov) reported suspected drone attack on Russian vessel at Benghazi naval base/port, with Libyan eastern government statements and no claimed responsibility.[[9]](https://x.com/begoniatulip/status/2124568465444884967)

**Assessment:** Attack disrupts Russian Africa Corps logistics via Libya; this extends Ukrainian reach and complicates Russian overseas sustainment. Moderate confidence from Libyan official statements and imagery-linked reporting.

### AMERICAS
Quiet in window beyond resolved FAA and bank outage reports. No new X chatter beyond news reposts.

### STRATEGIC AND SPACE
Quiet in window. No new official statements or releases on nuclear, missile or counterspace activity.

### ECONOMIC AND ENERGY PRESSURE
[OSINT - WEB] CISA KEV (20 Nov) added multiple actively exploited vulnerabilities (e.g., Apache Roller, VMware vCenter, SAP NetWeaver).[[9]](https://x.com/begoniatulip/status/2124568465444884967)

**Assessment:** Ongoing cyber exposure in critical sectors persists; no new major incidents reported in window. High confidence from government catalog.

leads worked: carried 4 of ~15 recent China MSA/NAVAREA warnings (Zhejiang live-fire, Liaoning/Hebei/Guangdong exercises, Hainan launch); searched Kyiv, Kerch, Hormuz, Riyadh, Poland, Kaliningrad, Bahrain hotspots—substantiated Ukraine/Russia/Middle East/Africa movement, no new Indo-Pacific or South Asia substantiation.

## 3. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
[OSINT - WEB] BleepingComputer (22 Nov) reported Cleverbridge data breach exposing customer credit card details including CVVs.[[9]](https://x.com/begoniatulip/status/2124568465444884967)

[OSINT - WEB] BleepingComputer (22 Nov) noted Signal updates blocking AI assistants from capturing chats on iOS/Android.[[9]](https://x.com/begoniatulip/status/2124568465444884967)

searched: CISA KEV headlines; no significant new X chatter on active exploitation.

**Assessment:** Routine vulnerability disclosures and vendor patches continue; no high-impact confirmed intrusions tied to state actors in window. Moderate confidence from vendor and government sources.

## 4. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE
Quiet in window beyond resolved FAA and bank outage reports. No new X chatter beyond news reposts.

searched: US bank outage; FAA ground stop.

**Assessment:** No new incidents affecting civil infrastructure or aviation in window. High confidence from absence in headlines and searches.

## FORECAST CHECK
1. TRIGGERED - Ukrainian deep strikes on Kerch Bridge rail span and logistics (including Sparta II and Benghazi vessels) reported above in Europe and chatter sections.
2. TRIGGERED - Multiple (third+) Hormuz tanker incidents with UKMTO advisories reported in Middle East and chatter.
3. NOT TRIGGERED - No Polish/NATO Article 4 or enhanced air policing request in window.
4. OPEN - Iranian tanker convoy or major Bahrain escalation remains possible but no convoy attempt confirmed yet.
5. NOT TRIGGERED - No confirmed strike on Kaliningrad naval base infrastructure beyond alerts and monitoring.

## INDICATORS AND WARNINGS
- Sustained Ukrainian strikes on additional Russian logistics nodes (Novorossiysk or additional bridge spans) within 48h -> further isolation of Crimea forces and Russian retaliation risk -> first on Ukrainian General Staff or Russian MoD statements -> likely.
- Additional tanker incident or major UKMTO/insurance advisory in Hormuz within 48h -> supertanker rates spike and Gulf shipping slowdown -> first on Lloyd’s or UKMTO notices -> roughly even chance.
- Iranian follow-on strikes on Gulf targets or US assets within 48h -> broader coalition response and oil price surge -> first on IRGC statements or US CENTCOM releases -> roughly even chance.
- Russian missile or drone spillover into Polish airspace with confirmed impact within 48h -> NATO air policing surge or consultations -> first on Polish MoD or NATO statements -> unlikely.

## COLLECTION GAPS
- Independent confirmation of exact damage extent to Kerch Bridge and specific Russian vessels (beyond one-side claims and unverified imagery).
- Verification of Iranian mine vs. projectile claims in Hormuz and precise targeting intent in Bahrain strikes.
- Details on any Russian MoD response to Benghazi or Kaliningrad incidents beyond initial alerts.

sections.Solar Activity: Past 24 h: Solar activity continued at very low levels with only B-level enhancements observed. There are only two active regions with spots on the visible disk: Region 4579 (N14W30, Hsx/alpha) and Region 4581 (S09E05, Dso/beta). Region 4579 lost most of its peripheral spots around the main leader spot, while Region 4581 lost spots in both the leader and trailer areas. An area of development was noted near S09W51 and will be monitored for possible numbering. No Earth-directed CMEs were identified in the available coronagraph imagery during the period.  Forecast: Solar activity is expected to be at very low levels, with a chance for C-class flares and a slight chance for M-class flares (R1-R2, Minor-Moderate) on 22-24 Nov.
sections.Energetic Particle: Past 24 h: The greater than 2 MeV electron flux remained at moderate levels. The greater than 10 MeV proton flux continued at background levels.  Forecast: The greater than 2 MeV electron flux is expected to be at moderate levels on 22-24 Nov. The greater than 10 MeV proton flux is expected to continue at background levels on through 24 Nov.
sections.Solar Wind: Past 24 h: Solar wind parameters continued to reflect a background solar wind regime, with total field fluctuating between 2-5 nT and the Bz component oscillating between +/- 3 nT for most of the period. The solar wind speed was around 330-350 km/s during most of the period and Phi was predominately positive. A weak enhancement, possibly associated with a SSBC, was observed at around 22/0630 UTC when total field increased to 8 nT, Bz saw a simultaneous southward deflection to -6 nT, wind speeds increased slightly to around 390 km/s, and Phi rotated into a negative orientation.  Forecast: Nominal solar wind conditions are likely to continue on 22 and 24 Nov, with a slight and short-lived disturbance possible on 23 Nov due to a low confidence glancing blow of CME from 19 Nov.
sections.Geospace: Past 24 h: Geomagnetic activity has been quiet.  Forecast: Quiet geomagnetic conditions are expected on 22 Nov and 24 Nov. Quiet to active periods are expected on 23 Nov, with a slight chance for isolated G1 (Minor) storming period due to the possible CME glancing influences.
